notes: DOMAIN: hihonor.com is an alias — https://www.hihonor.com/cn/phone/honor-magic-v-flip/ returns HTTP 301 to https://www.honor.com/cn/phone/honor-magic-v-flip/, so honor.com/cn IS HONOR's primary Chinese site and is cited as primary here. The /spec/ page is JS-rendered (WebFetch returned an empty frame); values were read from the page's own data-value attributes via the curl fallback. TRANSLATION: 长度 = length/height, 宽度 = width, 厚度 = thickness, 展开态 = unfolded state, 折叠态 = folded state, 重量 = weight, 约 = approximately, 克 = grams (约193克（含电池） = 'approx. 193 g, including battery' — kept HONOR's 约, not rounded away), 英寸 = inches, 内屏 = inner screen, 外屏 = cover screen, 像素 = pixels, 屏幕类型 = screen type. HONOR footnotes that the diagonals are standard-rectangle measurements and the real visible area is slightly smaller (rounded-corner design), and that thickness excludes the camera bump. INNER-SCREEN REFRESH LEFT NULL: the honor.com/cn spec page has NO refresh-rate row at all, and its only Hz figures are PWM dimming (内屏 3840Hz 超高频PWM调光, 外屏 2160Hz) which is NOT a refresh rate. The 0.1-120Hz LTPO figure on the product page and in the launch article is explicitly attributed to the 外屏 — '这块外屏引入旗舰全域低功耗LTPO屏幕，兼具0.1Hz-120Hz高刷新率与低功耗全屏显示的领先优势' = 'this cover screen adopts a flagship all-domain low-power LTPO panel, combining 0.1Hz-120Hz high refresh with low-power always-on display' — and a product-page footnote confirms '0.1Hz指外屏...'. The HONOR support page for this model carries no refresh figure either. Inner-panel 120Hz appears only on secondary sites (GSMArena/PhoneArena), so it is left null. hinge.crease LEFT NULL: HONOR names the hinge '荣耀鲁班铰链' (HONOR Luban hinge) built with '荣耀自研盾构钢' (self-developed shield-tunnelling steel) but never states a waterdrop/水滴 or U crease shape on any page I fetched. hinge.free_stop = true from '悬停自拍' ('hover selfie — frees your hands') on the product page, corroborated by '悬停拍摄' and '悬停自拍' in the launch article. materials ALL null: the launch article describes '柔和钻切直边中框' ('soft diamond-cut straight-edge middle frame'), a shape/finish rather than a material, and no 材质 / 玻璃 / 中框材质 row exists on the spec page. released: the year is not inside the 开售 sentence itself — it comes from the same article, dated 2024年6月13日 in its own description and HONOR_DREDATE meta 2024-06-13; '6月21日10:08开售' = 'on sale 21 June at 10:08'. panel recorded as OLED per the SPEC enum; HONOR gives ONE device-level 屏幕类型 OLED row, not split per screen. aspect left null (no ratio row published). controls left empty (not surveyed). || EVIDENCE SWEEP 2026-09-13: these values were present in the research pass but carried NO sources[] entry covering their field, so they were set to null per the registry rule (a value without a citation is an assertion, not evidence). Preserved verbatim here so a human can re-source rather than re-research: hinge.type = 'flip'; hinge.axis = 'short'.
